Manage the repositories

Usage: kit repo [options] <command>

Commands:
  add       Add a repository
  list, ls  List the repositories

Maintenance:
  Rarely needed by hand
  gc    Collect unreachable objects
  fsck  Verify the object store

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help

Output:
  How results are shown
  --color <auto|always|never>  When to colour the output [default: auto]

Global Options:
  -v, --verbose  Print more output

Run 'kit repo <command> --help' for more on a command.
